channel_ids.desc: List of encoded channel IDs to add to the channel restriction list. Interpretation depends on the app's `channel_restriction_mode`, which is configured via the `admin.apps.permissions.set` method.

user_ids.desc: List of user IDs to allow for named\_entities visibility. Pass either or both `user_ids` and `usergroup_ids` values to add those entities to the app's access list.

usergroup_ids.desc: List of encoded usergroup IDs. Pass either or both `user_ids` and `usergroup_ids` values to add those entities to the app's access list.

desc: Grant permission for entities to access an app that has its permission type set to named\_entities

errors.app_acl_not_found: This app does not have an ACL.
errors.channel_not_found: One or more channel IDs are not valid.
errors.failed_to_update_channels: An error occurred while updating the channel restriction list.
errors.invalid_channel_restriction_mode: Cannot add channels when channel\_restriction\_mode is all\_channels. Use set to configure a restriction mode first.
errors.invalid_permission_type: This app requires permission\_type to be set as named\_entities before adding users.
errors.no_valid_named_entities: None of the provided named entities were valid
errors.not_an_enterprise: This feature is only available on Enterprise Grid plans.
errors.restricted_action: User does not have permission to perform this action.
errors.too_many_named_entities: Too many named entities passed into the app permissions setting.
